description: Premium modern website for RiverFlow Psychology Services (bendpsychologist.com) — Dr. R. Andrew Barram, Psy.D., Licensed Psychologist in Bend, Oregon

userStories.title: Initialize Next.js project with design system foundations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Next.js project scaffolded with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and the design system (fonts, colors, base styles) configured.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 15 project initialized with App Router and TypeScript in src/ directory
Tailwind CSS v4 installed and configured
Playfair Display and Inter fonts loaded via next/font/google
Custom color palette defined (sage green #5B7B6A, charcoal #1A1A1A, off-white #FAFAF7, warm gray #F5F3EF, dark text #2D2D2D, gold accent #C4A962)
Global CSS with base typography styles applied (Playfair for headings, Inter for body)
Root layout.tsx with html lang, font classes, and metadata (title: 'RiverFlow Psychology Services | Dr. R. Andrew Barram, Psy.D.')
Clean homepage placeholder renders without errors
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Next.js 16.1.6 scaffolded with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4. Playfair Display and Inter fonts configured. Custom color palette (sage, charcoal, offwhite, warmgray, gold) defined in globals.css @theme. Typography system set with serif headings and sans body. Build and typecheck pass.

userStories.title: Build sticky navigation header
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a sticky navigation header so I can easily navigate between sections of the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Sticky header with backdrop blur on scroll
Logo/practice name 'RiverFlow Psychology' on the left using Playfair Display
Navigation links: About, Services, Specialties, FAQ, Contact — with smooth scroll to sections
Primary CTA button 'Request Consultation' with sage green background, uppercase text, rounded corners
Mobile hamburger menu that opens a full-screen or slide-out nav overlay
Header transitions from transparent to solid background on scroll
All links use smooth scroll behavior
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Sticky header with transparent-to-solid background transition on scroll, backdrop blur, Playfair Display logo, desktop nav links with smooth scroll, sage green CTA button, mobile hamburger with animated icon and full-screen overlay. Build and typecheck pass.

userStories.title: Build hero section

acceptanceCriteria: Full-viewport height hero section with charcoal (#1A1A1A) background
Gradient overlay (dark to darker) for depth, similar to movedacademy.com
Placeholder for background image (use a muted nature/river-themed Unsplash image or solid gradient)
Large Playfair Display headline (text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl): compelling tagline about finding clarity, resilience, or a path forward
Subtitle in Inter with lighter weight describing the practice briefly
Two CTA buttons: primary 'Schedule a Consultation' and secondary ghost/outline 'Learn More'
Uppercase micro-label above headline (e.g., 'BEND, OREGON · LICENSED PSYCHOLOGIST') with tracking-widest
Scroll indicator at bottom (subtle animated chevron or line)
Fully responsive across breakpoints

userStories.notes: Full-viewport hero with charcoal background, gradient overlays, Playfair Display headline with sage accent, subtitle, dual CTA buttons (primary sage + ghost outline), micro-label with tracking, animated scroll indicator. Fully responsive. Build and typecheck pass.

userStories.title: SEO, metadata, accessibility, and final polish
userStories.description: As a developer, I need proper SEO, metadata, and accessibility to ensure the site is discoverable and usable by everyone.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete metadata in layout.tsx: title, description, openGraph tags, keywords
Semantic HTML throughout (header, main, section, nav, footer, article elements)
All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Proper heading hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3)
Alt text on all images/placeholders
Focus-visible styles on interactive elements
Smooth scroll behavior set in CSS (scroll-behavior: smooth)
Proper aria-labels on navigation, mobile menu toggle, accordion buttons
favicon placeholder configured
robots.txt and sitemap consideration in next.config
npm run build passes with zero errors and zero warnings
Typecheck passes
